hook.en: Your bill is the price of each item times how many you bought, all added up. Matrix multiplication does exactly this: row times column, then add.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಿಲ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಬೆಲೆ × ಪ್ರಮಾಣ, ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದ್ದು. ಮಾತೃಕೆ ಗುಣಾಕಾರವೂ ಇದೇ: ಸಾಲು × ಕಂಬಸಾಲು, ನಂತರ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

objectives.en: Decide when AB is defined and find its order
See that AB ≠ BA in general

narration.en: Your bill is the price of each item times how many you bought, all added up. Matrix multiplication does exactly this: row times column, then add.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಿಲ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ವಸ್ತುವಿನ ಬೆಲೆ × ಪ್ರಮಾಣ, ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಕೂಡಿಸಿದ್ದು. ಮಾತೃಕೆ ಗುಣಾಕಾರವೂ ಇದೇ: ಸಾಲು × ಕಂಬಸಾಲು, ನಂತರ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

body.en: If $A$ is $m \times n$ and $B$ is $n \times p$, then $AB$ is the $m \times p$ matrix with $(AB)_{ik} = \sum_{j} a_{ij} b_{jk}$: multiply row $i$ of $A$ with column $k$ of $B$ term by term and add. $AB$ is defined only when columns of $A$ = rows of $B$.
body.kn: A, m × n ಮತ್ತು B, n × p ಆದರೆ AB, m × p. A ಯ i ನೇ ಸಾಲನ್ನು B ಯ k ನೇ ಕಂಬಸಾಲಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪದದಿಂದ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಗುಣಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

points.en: Inner orders must match: (m × n)(n × p) = m × p
Row of A into column of B

narration.en: To multiply, take a row of A and a column of B, multiply matching entries and add. The product exists only when the number of columns of A equals the number of rows of B.
narration.kn: A, m × n ಮತ್ತು B, n × p ಆದರೆ AB, m × p. A ಯ i ನೇ ಸಾಲನ್ನು B ಯ k ನೇ ಕಂಬಸಾಲಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪದದಿಂದ ಪದಕ್ಕೆ ಗುಣಿಸಿ ಕೂಡಿಸಿ.

say.en: A m by n matrix times an n by p matrix: the inner numbers must match, and the outer numbers give the order of the product.
Each entry is a row of A times a column of B: multiply term by term and add. Row 1 with column 1 gives 1 times 5 plus 2 times 7, that is 19.
Doing all four entries gives AB. Now swap the order: BA is a different matrix. Matrix multiplication is not commutative.
Even stranger: two non-zero matrices can multiply to give the zero matrix.

narration.en: On the board: Row times column.
A rotates by α; B stretches across by s. (AB)v = A(Bv): stretch first, then rotate. (BA)v: rotate first, then stretch. The two images of the letter F usually differ, so AB ≠ BA.
narration.kn: A, α ಕೋನ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; B ಅಡ್ಡಲಾಗಿ s ಪಟ್ಟು ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. (AB)v = A(Bv): ಮೊದಲು ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ. (BA)v: ಮೊದಲು ತಿರುಗಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸಿ. F ಅಕ್ಷರದ ಎರಡು ಬಿಂಬಗಳು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಬೇರೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ AB ≠ BA.

caption.en: A rotates by α; B stretches across by s. (AB)v = A(Bv): stretch first, then rotate. (BA)v: rotate first, then stretch. The two images of the letter F usually differ, so AB ≠ BA.

tryThis.en: With α = 90° and s = 2, compare the yellow and dashed images.
Find settings where AB = BA. (Try s = 1, or α = 180°.)
Multiply the matrices on paper and check the readouts.

body.en:
Matrix multiplication is associative, $(AB)C = A(BC)$, and distributive, $A(B + C) = AB + AC$; $AI = IA = A$. But it is not commutative: usually $AB 
e BA$. Also $AB = O$ is possible with $A 
e O$ and $B 
e O$.
body.kn: ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಸಹವರ್ತನೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭಾಜಕ; AI = IA = A. ಆದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ AB ≠ BA. A ≠ O, B ≠ O ಆದರೂ AB = O ಆಗಬಹುದು.

points.en: AB = O does not force A = O or B = O

narration.en: Multiplication is associative and distributive, and the identity changes nothing. But AB and BA are usually different, and two non-zero matrices can multiply to zero.
narration.kn: ಗುಣಾಕಾರ ಸಹವರ್ತನೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಭಾಜಕ; AI = IA = A. ಆದರೆ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ AB ≠ BA. A ≠ O, B ≠ O ಆದರೂ AB = O ಆಗಬಹುದು.

caption.en: A = [a b; c d] is yours to set; B = [1 2; 3 4] is fixed. Compare the first row of AB with the first row of BA.

tryThis.en: Set A = I (a = d = 1, b = c = 0). Do AB and BA agree?
Set A = B. Why must AB = BA now?
Find another A with AB = BA.

narration.en: Move the entries of A. In general AB and BA differ. Find choices of A that make them agree.

problem.en: A = [1 2; 3 4], B = [0 1; 1 0]. Find AB and BA.

steps.en: BA: row 1 of B picks row 2 of A, row 2 picks row 1: BA = [3 4; 1 2].

body.en: Write the orders side by side: (m × n)(n × p). If the two inside numbers match, the product exists and its order is the two outside numbers.

narration.en: Order check in two seconds. Write the orders side by side: (m × n)(n × p). If the two inside numbers match, the product exists and its order is the two outside numbers.

mnemonic.en: Inside must match, outside is the answer

points.kn: AB ಯ ಕ್ರಮ: (m × n)(n × p) = m × p.

points.en: AB ≠ BA in general; AB = O does not mean A = O or B = O.
